1.title: Plug in the two battery wires
1.say: Hold the small board steady with one hand. Push the left battery wire into a top empty five-hole row. Push the right battery wire into another top empty five-hole row.
placements: left battery lead → a hole in the top half on the left side in its own five-hole row (in the video: white wire at top left edge)
right battery lead → a hole in the top half on the right side in a different five-hole row from the left lead (in the video: blue wire at top right edge)
watch_for: if both wires sit in the same five-hole row the batteries are joined, move one wire to a different row
if a wire wobbles or falls out it is not in far enough, push gently until it grips
1.check_yourself: It should look like two thin wires standing up from the top of the board.

2.title: Lay the resistor across the board
2.say: Pick up the tiny striped resistor by its middle. Push one thin leg into the left wire row. Push the other thin leg into an empty middle row.
placements: small striped resistor → one thin leg in the same five-hole row as the left battery wire and the other thin leg in an empty middle five-hole row across the centre gap (in the video: lying across the top half)
watch_for: if both legs sit in the same five-hole row the part does nothing, move one leg to a different row
if the thin legs touch each other above the board, spread them so only the tips go in
2.check_yourself: It should look like a tiny striped bridge lying flat on the board.

3.title: Plug in the LED
3.say: Find the longer leg of the small light. Push the longer leg into the resistor middle row. Push the shorter leg into the right wire row.
placements: small light with two legs → longer leg in the same five-hole row as the resistor middle end and shorter leg in the same five-hole row as the right battery wire on the right side (in the video: right edge with longer leg left and shorter leg right)
watch_for: if the light stays dark the legs are probably swapped, pull it out and switch the two holes
if a leg shares the wrong row the circle is broken, legs must sit in the two rows described
3.check_yourself: It should look like a tiny light standing up and glowing.
